notes.title: What are we going to do next
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players,
Our game is currently in early access. However, somehow it was released without early access label. We are communicating with the Steam support team to roll things back.
Whatever...
As the first step, we want to ensure that our servers are working without any issues. Thanks to everyone who has already tried our game. Hope you faced fewer problems than our QA guy last month.
We're still waiting for build approval at AppLab. Hope you'll be able to play with your friends, who have Quests at theirs. Yes, the crossplay is available.
We'll continue to develop the game to make every session unique, adding more maps, challenges, and powerups for players.
If you'll run into any kind of crashes or strange game behavior, please share on Steam or our Discord server. Thanks again for your time spent on the game and reviews.
